svg.title: Svalbard archipelago, topographic plate
svg.desc: Polar stereographic map derived from Natural Earth 1:10m land and Mapzen Terrain Tiles zoom 6. Smoothed elevation contours every 100 m. Scale at 79° N. See plate-sources.txt for attribution.
